warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender D240 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ200D is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
Because the Defender D240 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Defender 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ200D specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
